text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...
Interval training.
Build up speed.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy~! 
Kris S, mind if I sit next to you, DE-SU-KA?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hard at work? 
You've got quite a lot of materials there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Is this... an American training book, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. ...For Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...She wanted... American training materials.
I accepted... the request.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, Kris S is always looking out for Rob Roy, DESU NE~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? Were you not aware of it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look at how thoroughly you compiled those notes with Rob Roy in mind...
And what you're looking at right now, isn't that for her too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...? This is...
American-made... training gear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Ordering it... for Rob Roy.
I judged... that this too... would be useful.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, see? You went beyond the scope of her request, acting "for Rob Roy's sake."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I think that's proof of how closely you're watching her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
She just... catches my eye... often.
Ever since... the day we met...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Eep... Did you see that? That run just now...
It's amazing... but kinda super terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, is she... angry...? 
F-For now, let's just practice over in the corner...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What a splendid run...!
I'd love to scout her... but,
...maybe I shouldn't talk to her right now...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...!
Symboli Kris S-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... was so deeply moved!!
Your running has such majestic dignity, a truly heroic presence...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, *haa*, I-I finally caught up...!
I'm so sorry, my pacing is completely unstable...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But surely one day... I will catch up to Kris S-san—
No, I'll grow enough to surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy is... always,
...running after... my back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Unusual.
So... she caught my eye...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............I see her clearly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes, the gaze you direct toward Rob Roy is always gentle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy is super cute DESU! 
I totally understand wanting to watch her all the time, MA-SU!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, overhearing the exchange
at the neighboring table brought
a warm smile to my face.
